DND5ECOMBAT.DegatsBonusDivergents: Bonus damage not added, not every target qualifies: {names}

DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.noBonus: You already used your Bonus Action this turn.

DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.outOfReach: {name} is beyond your reach. To throw the weapon, choose the "Thrown" mode in the attack roll.

DND5ECOMBAT.Raison.closeCombat: ranged attack in close combat (enemy within 5 ft)
DND5ECOMBAT.Raison.unseen.target: target not seen by the attacker
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.cover.Aide: The engine works out cover for every attack (lines from the attacker's corners to the target's corners, against walls that block movement and creatures in between — Half Cover at most): +2 AC for Half Cover, +5 for Three-Quarters Cover, and Total Cover makes the target impossible to hit. Nothing is placed on the token; a cover status set by hand takes precedence.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.vision.Aide: The engine judges who sees whom (vision, light, walls, senses): attacking a target you cannot see gives Disadvantage, attacking while unseen gives Advantage; Blinded and Invisible are judged through the observer's senses. Off: those conditions keep their flat effect.
DND5ECOMBAT.VisionHorsService: dnd5e-combat: simulated vision is unavailable, the core API changed ({missing}). Conditions keep their flat effect.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.volumes.Aide: Spell areas get a height from their shape (sphere centered on the caster, cube and cylinder resting on the ground, cone and line flat): a creature flying above a Fireball is no longer hit. A floor or ceiling (a Surface region that blocks movement) cuts the line of effect of areas, auras and Opportunity Attacks, and counts as Total Cover. Distances are measured in three dimensions regardless of this setting.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.altitude.Aide: Walking and crawling happen on the ground (the Surface that blocks movement under the token, otherwise the base of its level), flying at least 5 ft above it, burrowing at least 5 ft below it. Changing mode takes off, lands or digs in, paid from movement; raising or lowering the elevation field makes the creature fly or burrow. On the ground, a step is 5 ft at most: higher requires climbing, lower is a fall (dnd5e's Falling status).
DND5ECOMBAT.Altitude.SansVitesse: {name} cannot move this way ({mode}): its sheet has no such speed.
DND5ECOMBAT.Altitude.BetterLevels: dnd5e-combat: Baileywiki Better Levels' "Set elevation on level change" setting is on. It puts a token back at the bottom of its level on every level change, which undoes "Movement modes and elevation" (a flying token changing floors is set back on the ground). Turn it off: the engine already puts the token on the new level's ground, according to its mode.
DND5ECOMBAT.Altitude.Impossible: {name} cannot change movement mode now (movement spent or refused).
DND5ECOMBAT.Altitude.TropHaut: {name} cannot walk up that high: climbing is required.
DND5ECOMBAT.VolumesHorsService: dnd5e-combat: elevation and volumes are unavailable, the core API changed ({missing}). Spell areas stay without height.
DND5ECOMBAT.CiblesDivergentes: The targets don't call for the same Advantage: set it by hand for this roll.

DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.aurasOnlyInCombat.ai: Out of combat, passive auras (Aura of Protection…) are no longer computed and their effects are removed from allies. Lightens exploration scenes; a save's bonus out of combat must then be added by hand.
DND5ECOMBAT.Deplacement.Epuise: Movement spent for this turn. The Dash action grants more.
DND5ECOMBAT.Deplacement.Effraye: {name} is Frightened of {source}: can't willingly move closer.

DND5ECOMBAT.Teleport.CaseOccupee: Teleport: the space must be unoccupied.
DND5ECOMBAT.Teleport.NonVue: Teleport: you must be able to see the space.
DND5ECOMBAT.Ruee.Choisir: {item}: click the destination, in a straight line and within your Speed (right-click or Esc to cancel).
DND5ECOMBAT.Ruee.SurPlace: Rush: pick a space other than your own.
DND5ECOMBAT.Ruee.Mur: Rush: a wall blocks the straight line.
DND5ECOMBAT.Ruee.PasDeZone: {item}: no area to place — the creatures near the path are already targeted.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.autoUsage.Aide: An activity consumes its resources, starts Concentration and places its area without asking (slot used up: the lowest one left). A spell that can be cast at a higher level keeps the window, to pick the level. Out of resources: the window opens for the GM only; a player gets dnd5e's warning.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.teleportPlanning.Nom: Teleport: pick the destination right away
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.teleportPlanning.Aid: After Misty Step or Dimension Door, destination picking opens at once (otherwise, use the card's Teleport button).
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.targetingBanner.Aide: While targeting (a target, projectiles, an area, a destination), the instruction and the number of targets picked stay at the top of the screen. Off: the instruction is only a notification.
DND5ECOMBAT.Deplacement.CibleHorsDattein: {name} is out of reach this turn.
DND5ECOMBAT.Deplacement.CibleHorsDeVue: No reachable space with a line of sight to {name}.
DND5ECOMBAT.Visee.Choisir: {name}: click the target (right-click or Esc to cancel).
DND5ECOMBAT.Relever.noMovement: Not enough movement to stand up
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.clickToMove.Aide: A left click on the ground moves the selected token around obstacles.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.clickToAttack.Aide: A left click on an enemy makes the basic attack, moving into reach first if needed. For the GM this click no longer selects that token.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.targetingMode.Aide: An attack or spell used without a target waits for a click on its target.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.fastAttack.Aide: Attacks started with the mouse roll without the configuration dialog; Advantage and Disadvantage come from the engine.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.quickRolls.Aide: Attack, damage and healing rolls from a spell or a weapon are rolled straight away, without dnd5e's configuration dialog; Advantage and Disadvantage come from the engine.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.pathPreview.Aide: Shows the path that will be taken under the pointer.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.releaseTargets.Aide: Targets are released once the action is resolved (attack, saves), and at the end of your turn.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.faceMovement.Nom: Turn tokens to face their movement
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.faceMovement.Aide: A walking token turns toward where it goes (art assumed to face south at rotation 0, the core convention); it keeps the rotation of its last step. Not for teleports or tokens with locked rotation.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.hitChance.Aide: Next to the cursor, the chance to hit the hovered target with the attack a click would make (basic attack in combat, or an attack in targeting mode): attack bonus, AC, cover, Advantage and Disadvantage, critical threshold. If the click moves you closer first, the chance is worked out from where you would stop.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.hitChancePlayers.Aid: The GM always sees everything. Players can see the percentage and the target's AC (as in BG3), the percentage only, or nothing.
DND5ECOMBAT.AbriNonEvalue: Cover not assessed for this attack: view the scene "{scene}" (the engine reads walls and creatures from the active GM's canvas).
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.feedbackText.Aide: Text scrolls above the target when the engine settles something: critical, miss, cover, Reaction, save succeeded or failed. HP loss is still shown by the system.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.chatLight.Aide: Smoother chat: the engine merges the steps of an action that follow each other quickly into a single update of its card (instead of redrawing it at every step for every player), and cards that are off screen in the chat log are no longer drawn. Off: every step is written at once, as before.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.chatCompact.Aide: Like Midi-QOL's merged card: an action's attack and damage roll cards are hidden in the chat log, and their summary (total, d20, damage by type, Advantage reasons) is shown on the action's card, above the verdict. The rolls are still stored (3D dice, animations, undo); the "Details" button shows them again. Saving throws are already summarized by dnd5e ("Summary Chat Cards" setting).
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.perfWarnMs.Aide: On this client, an engine handler that blocks the browser longer than this is reported in the console (F12). Full report: game.modules.get("dnd5e-combat").api.perf.table(). 0: no reports.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.chatPurgeMax.Aide: When the chat log holds more messages than this, the active GM permanently deletes the oldest ones (never an action still in progress). 0: never.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.chatPurgeKeep.Aide: Number of recent messages kept after a purge.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.situationalCursor.Ai: On the canvas, the cursor shows what a click would do: move, make a melee or ranged attack, cast a spell, target out of range this turn, or not possible (no path, no movement left, targeting yourself).
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.closeSheetOnUse.Nom: Close the sheet when picking an attack or a spell
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.closeSheetOnUse.Aide: Using an attack or a spell from the character sheet closes it, to clear the view of the map (targeting mode included).
DND5ECOMBAT.Action.dash.Texte: Action: this turn your movement is doubled (the engine raises the turn's movement cap).
DND5ECOMBAT.Action.disengage.Texte: Action: until the end of the turn, your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.
DND5ECOMBAT.Action.dodge.Texte: Action: until the start of your next turn, attack rolls against you have Disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws. The effect ends if you have the Incapacitated condition or your Speed drops to 0.
DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.noLightAttack: Off-hand attack: you must first attack with a Light weapon as part of the Attack action this turn.
The engine adds to every character (played by a player or by the GM) the basic action items they lack: Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Ready, Help, Hide, Escape and the Unarmed Strike (Grapple, Shove). Always: when the world loads, when a character is created, when a combat starts. They show on the sheet (features; the Unarmed Strike under inventory) and in the action bar. Nothing is removed, nothing is placed on NPCs.
DND5ECOMBAT.Action.unarmed.Texte: A punch, kick, head-butt…: 1 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage. Or, instead of damage, Grapple or Shove: the target, within 5 feet and no more than one size larger than you, makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (its choice) against DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus. On a failure, Grapple: it has the Grappled condition; Shove: you push it 5 feet away or give it the Prone condition.
DND5ECOMBAT.Action.escape.Texte: Action: you try to escape a grapple. Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, whichever is better, against DC 8 + the grappler's Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus. On a success, you're no longer Grappled.
DND5ECOMBAT.Empoignade.Rompue: {name} is no longer Grappled by {by} (out of reach or grappler Incapacitated).
DND5ECOMBAT.Empoignade.DDInconnu: {name} is Grappled, but by whom is unknown: the GM sets the DC.
DND5ECOMBAT.Action.ready.Texte: Action: you prepare an action and the trigger for it. When the trigger occurs before the start of your next turn, you take the readied action with your Reaction (by hand). The "Ready" status reminds you of it on your token.
DND5ECOMBAT.Action.help.Texte: Action: you distract an enemy within 5 feet. The next attack roll by one of your allies against it, before the start of your next turn, has Advantage. Out of combat, an ally proficient in a check's skill or tool can also give you Advantage: the roll window offers it ("Aid" section).
DND5ECOMBAT.Action.hide.Texte: Action: you try to hide. You must be Heavily Obscured or behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover, and out of any enemy's line of sight. DC 15 Dexterity (Stealth) check: on a success you have the Invisible condition while hidden, and your total is the DC to find you (Wisdom (Perception)). You stop hiding after an attack roll or a spell with a Verbal component (automatic), or if you make noise or are found (the GM removes the effect).
DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.hideSeen: Hide: these enemies can see you — {names}.
DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.silenced: Silenced: a spell with a Verbal component can't be cast.
DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.noReactions: An effect prevents it from taking Reactions.
DND5ECOMBAT.Huile.Enflammee: The oil covering {name} catches fire: 5 fire damage.
DND5ECOMBAT.Amadou.Rien: No candle, lamp, lantern or torch to light
DND5ECOMBAT.Lumiere.PasDeMain: {item}: no free hand to hold it ({held}). Stow a weapon or switch weapon sets.
DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.incapacitated: Incapacitated: no action, Bonus Action or Reaction can be taken.
DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.charmed: Charmed by {name}: can't attack them or target them with damage or a magical effect.
DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.notSeen: {name} can't be seen: this spell targets a creature you can see.
DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.hiddenTarget: {name} is hidden: you don't know where it is (find it first).
DND5ECOMBAT.Mort.SurLeCoup: {name} dies outright: {remainder} damage beyond 0 Hit Points, against {max} maximum Hit Points.
DND5ECOMBAT.Mort.TroisEchecs: {name} dies: three failed Death Saving Throws.
DND5ECOMBAT.Mort.Echec: {name} takes damage at 0 Hit Points: one Death Saving Throw failure ({failures}/3).
DND5ECOMBAT.Mort.EchecsCritique: {name} takes a Critical Hit at 0 Hit Points: two Death Saving Throw failures ({failures}/3).
DND5ECOMBAT.Mort.Stabilise: {name}: three successful Death Saving Throws, now Stable.
DND5ECOMBAT.Mort.DemandeJoueur: Start of {name}'s turn: Death Saving Throw.
DND5ECOMBAT.Action.search.Texte: Action: you make a Wisdom (Perception) check to find a hidden creature. Each hostile hidden creature you could see is found if your total meets its DC (its Stealth total); once found, it is no longer hidden. Disadvantage if it is in an area Lightly Obscured for you (Dim Light; Darkness with Darkvision); impossible behind a wall, in fog or in darkness you cannot pierce. A creature your senses perceive despite the Invisible condition (Blindsight, Truesight) is found without a roll. (Searching for an object or a clue is up to the GM.)
DND5ECOMBAT.Lumiere.dim.Texte: Lightly Obscured: Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to see you here. Not enough to hide.
DND5ECOMBAT.Lumiere.dark.Texte: Heavily Obscured: creatures without Darkvision cannot see you here. You can try to hide.
DND5ECOMBAT.Lumiere.magical.Texte: Even Darkvision cannot see you here (only Truesight, Devil's Sight or Blindsight). You can try to hide.
DND5ECOMBAT.Lumiere.Vous: To your own eyes, it is {level} here.
DND5ECOMBAT.PerceptionPassive.Repere: Passive Perception (DC {dc}): {observers}. {name} is no longer hidden.
DND5ECOMBAT.PerceptionPassive.RepereMJ: Passive Perception (DC {dc}) against {name}'s Hide: {observers}. Your call whether it ends.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.passivePerception.Ai: When a creature hides, then whenever it or one of its enemies moves: an enemy whose Passive Perception meets the hiding DC spots it (−5 if it sees it in Dim Light, never if it cannot see it). Automatic: Hide is removed and the GM and the player are told. GM only: a private message to the GM, who decides.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.lightIndicator.Aide: On the action bar portrait (Darsh UI DnD5), a badge (sun, half moon, moon) shows the light your token stands in and, on hover, what it means: Disadvantage on Perception to see you in Dim Light, unseen by creatures without Darkvision in Darkness.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.twilightDarkness.Aid: Above this scene darkness level, a bright global light counts as Dim Light for the engine (dawn and dusk), until it goes out at the end of its range. Useful with a time module that changes darkness (Simple Timekeeping). 1: never. Foundry's display does not change.
DND5ECOMBAT.ChoixSauvegarde.Texte: {item} — choose the ability for the saving throw (DC {dc}).
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.npcSaveChoice.Aide: When a saving throw lets the target choose its ability (Grapple, Shove: Strength or Dexterity), a player always chooses in a window. For a target played by the GM (NPC, character with no player online): ask the GM, or take the best.
When an NPC with Legendary Resistances left fails a saving throw during a resolution: ask the GM (a window, closed as "no" when the combat window delay runs out), always spend one, or never (the system's "Legendary Resistance" button stays on the save card).
DND5ECOMBAT.Legendaire.Question: {name} fails a saving throw ({total} against DC {dc}, {item}). Spend a Legendary Resistance ({left} left) to succeed instead?
DND5ECOMBAT.Empoignade.Immobile: {name} is Grappled: Speed 0. To break free: Escape (right-click their token).
DND5ECOMBAT.Porte.HorsDatteinte: The door is out of reach this turn.
Reaction, Opportunity Attack, saving throw or effect choice, a player's saving throw: with no answer within this delay, the window resolves on its own — no Reaction, the best saving throw, the first option, the roll made without a dialog.

DND5ECOMBAT.Avale.Interdit: {source} can't use {item} while it has a creature swallowed.

DND5ECOMBAT.Pacte.TypeAChaqueAttaque: The damage type (normal, necrotic, psychic or radiant) is chosen on each attack.
DND5ECOMBAT.Enchant.SansMJ: Enchantment: no GM connected to apply it.
DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.oncePerTurn: Already used this turn (once on each of your turns).
DND5ECOMBAT.Souci.notEmpty: You still have uses of {item}: this is only possible when none are left.
DND5ECOMBAT.Forme.ReprendreAide: Bonus Action: you leave your Wild Shape and return to your normal form.
DND5ECOMBAT.Forme.SansMJ: Wild Shape: no GM connected to transform you.
DND5ECOMBAT.Forme.Refus.cr: CR too high for your level
DND5ECOMBAT.Retour.PasAStabiliser: Nothing to stabilize: {name} is not at 0 HP, or already is

DND5ECOMBAT.DernierRempart: {item}: {name} stays up with 1 Hit Point, and everything affecting them ends.
DND5ECOMBAT.Automatisation.rule.Aide: The engine has a rule of its own for this item, on top of the roll and effects.
DND5ECOMBAT.Automatisation.auto.Aide: The item's rolls, damage, healing and effects are rolled by dnd5e and resolved by the engine, with no special rule.
DND5ECOMBAT.Automatisation.passive.Aide: Nothing to use: permanent effects that dnd5e applies on its own.
DND5ECOMBAT.Automatisation.manual.Aide: No roll, no effect, no engine rule: play it by hand.
DND5ECOMBAT.Signalement.Poser: Report a problem with this item
DND5ECOMBAT.Signalement.Aide: The item caused a problem during the session. An optional note helps find out what: everything is reviewed in the session report.
DND5ECOMBAT.Signalement.Exemple: E.g. the save wasn't requested on the second cast
DND5ECOMBAT.Bilan.Aide: Items flagged during the session (flag on the sheet), by character: review, copy or send to chat at the end of the session.
DND5ECOMBAT.Reglage.automationBadges.Aid: On the sheet, each item carries a badge (engine, auto, passive, manual) and a flag to report a problem during play. GM only.

DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.bonusDamage.Aide: Adds damage to the bearer's damage rolls that meet the condition (Hex, Spirit Shroud).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.attackModifier.Aide: Grants Advantage or Disadvantage on an attack roll under a condition (Faerie Fire, Pack Tactics).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.outcomeStatus.Aide: Applies a condition to a target that is hit or fails its save (Prone, Grappled).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.forcedMove.Aide: Moves a target that is hit or fails its save (Thunderwave, Thorn Whip).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.repeatSave.Aide: A creature bearing an effect of this item repeats the save; on a success the effect ends (Hold Person).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.endsOnDamage.Aide: An effect of this item ends when its bearer takes damage (Sleep, Hypnotic Pattern).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.lastingZone.Aide: The area placed by the item repeats its activity on creatures that enter it, or start or end their turn there (Moonbeam, Spirit Guardians).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.reaction.Aide: Offers to use the item as a Reaction at a given moment (Shield, Hellish Rebuke).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.retaliation.Aide: A creature that hits the bearer takes damage (Fire Shield, Corrosive Form).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.aura.Aide: Creatures near the bearer receive the item's effects (Aura of Protection).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.hitThenSave.Aide: An attack of the item that hits forces the save of another of its activities (Poisonous Bite).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.teleport.Aide: The bearer picks an unoccupied destination within range and in sight (Misty Step).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.summon.Aide: The summoned creature joins combat and vanishes when Concentration ends (Summon spells).
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.usageLimit.Aide: Limits an activity (once per turn) or changes its action cost.
DND5ECOMBAT.Recette.effectsExpire.Aide: The item's effects end on the chosen rest (Mage Armor).

DND5ECOMBAT.Niveau.Aide: Essentials: mouse-driven movement, context menus, turn budget, vision and interface; rolls stay dnd5e's own. Assisted: rolls are also chained and resolved (attack, damage applied, saving throws) with the general rules (conditions, cover, Concentration, 0 Hit Points, Opportunity Attacks). Full: plus the automation specific to each spell, feature and monster. The settings below fine-tune each level. Changing the level reloads the world.

DND5ECOMBAT.Niveau.assisted: Assisted — resolved rolls and general rules
DND5ECOMBAT.Niveau.full: Full — all automation, spell by spell
